$comment: Human decisions that used to block a turn. Each has a recommended option; script/auto options are executable by scripts/choice-gate.py, human options print the exact commands. This is the multiple-choice surface, not a hidden default.

choices.question: Revoke the old OpenCode console credential now?
choices.why: Rotation already replaced the value; the old console token remains valid until revoked. No CLI exists for revocation, so this is a browser step.

options.label: Open the console, revoke the old token, then rotate
Defer one sweep and keep the residual visible
Accept the residual and record why

choices.question: Update the open browser tabs with the new Basic-auth password?
choices.why: Tabs hold the previous password in memory; they fail silently until reloaded. This is a local, reversible action.

options.label: Open the rotation pages and reload the auth tabs
Print the exact tab URLs for a manual reload

choices.question: What should happen to the historical secret rows in the chat DB?
choices.why: The session store is read-only by contract; editing it would break the audit trail. The safe move is to rotate values and keep the store as evidence.

options.label: Re-scan the chat DB and confirm only historical rows remain
Accept as a documented residual (read-only store)

choices.question: Re-probe the Nebula tunnel link now, or keep watching the external issue?
choices.why: The last probe saw no churn and 0% overlay loss; the open unit is external (proxmox-dual-plane-mesh#5). Re-probe only when T8 trips or the issue changes.

options.label: Run the read-only tunnel probe now
Keep the external issue open and let the daily sweep poll it
Mark the external unit accepted and stop polling

choices.question: How should the model-level prompt-injection residual be handled?
choices.why: The blast radius is bounded by opencode.json (deny secret/cert reads, ask on task/webfetch). The remaining risk is model compliance, not filesystem reach.

options.label: Keep the current deny/ask policy and recheck after model changes
Tighten the policy (deny task/webfetch) and re-run hygiene
